summary: Verified the punycode deployment-build fix for VaidyaJi (Expo SDK 57). Independent verification: (1) 'npx expo export --platform web' — the exact bundling step that failed in the Emergent deploy — now completes with EXPORT_SUCCESS and zero punycode/markdown-it/'Unable to resolve' errors in the log; dist/ output generated. (2) Web preview boots clean at localhost:3000 — home screen renders, no red box, zero console errors/warnings, no module resolution errors. (3) /support-chat loads with seed AI bubble visible, rendered through the Markdown component (react-native-markdown-display, support-chat.tsx:87 — the feature that introduced the markdown-it dependency); sc-back/sc-input/sc-send all visible. (4) /chatbot loads with seed AI bubble; chatbot-back/chatbot-input visible. punycode 2.3.1 confirmed in package.json dependencies and installed in node_modules. All 3 test criteria PASS. Fix is verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: punycode 2.3.1 correctly added as direct dependency in frontend/package.json:47 and present in node_modules — resolves markdown-it → linkify-it core-module import in Metro's clean build environment.

Assistant bubbles render via react-native-markdown-display Markdown component (support-chat.tsx:87, chatbot.tsx equivalent) with custom mdStyles mirroring bubbleText — the runtime path through markdown-it/linkify-it/punycode is exercised on screen load and renders correctly.

Old 'Unable to resolve socket.io-client' entries exist in expo.out.log but are stale (from before a node_modules reinstall); socket.io-client is installed and current Metro session shows no such errors.
Note: expo 57.0.21 has an available update to ~57.0.27 (Metro startup notice) — informational only, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None — used built-in seed assistant messages on /support-chat and /chatbot (no login required)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Punycode build fix fully verified: expo export --platform web succeeds and both chat screens render markdown AI bubbles with zero console errors. The /support-chat and /chatbot routes are public on web preview (no auth needed). Assistant seed bubbles render through the Markdown component, so a missing punycode would fail at bundle time — screen rendering is itself proof of the fix.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: react-native-markdown-display 7.0.2 → markdown-it → linkify-it imports Node core 'punycode', which is unavailable in Metro's clean production bundling environment, causing 'Unable to resolve module punycode from markdown-it/lib/index.js' during the Emergent deploy expo bundle step. Fix: punycode 2.3.1 (browser-compatible fork by mathiasbynens) added as a direct dependency so Metro can resolve it. Verified: (a) npx expo export --platform web completes successfully with clean log; (b) web preview boots with no red box and no module-resolution console errors; (c) /support-chat and /chatbot render their Markdown-based AI bubbles correctly. Mitigation in place and working — safe to redeploy.
